products.title: Products
products.subtitle: What the organization makes or buys, named on every document: quotations, orders, production, quality and purchasing.
products.emptyHint: Until the first product is added, product types are still typed freely on every screen.
products.formSubtitle: Its names in both languages, its key (how every module refers to it) and its specification template.
products.keyHint: Saved as: {key}. Small English letters, digits and _; it cannot be changed later.
products.keyFixed: Every module stores this key, so it never changes.

template.title: Specification template
template.hint: The properties a line of this product carries, in the order documents print them.
template.keyInvalid: The key uses small English letters, digits and _ and starts with a letter (e.g. width_mm).

legacy.title: Product types written before the list
legacy.hint: These were typed freely on records. Map each one to a product: every module then stores that product's key on its own records.
legacy.mapped: «{value}» now refers to the product on {count} records.

select.noCatalog: No products are defined yet: type the product type.

settings.title: General settings
settings.subtitle: The VAT rate and the default currency of new quotations and purchase orders.
settings.vatHint: 15 in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
settings.currencyHint: Chosen first on new quotations and purchase orders; each document may change it.
settings.vatInvalid: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 (up to two decimals).
settings.note: Documents already written keep their rate; a document with VAT offers this rate or none.

errors.PRODUCT_KEY_TAKEN: Another product already has the key {key}.
errors.PROPERTY_KEY_INVALID: A property key is not valid: {key}.
errors.OPTIONS_INVALID: The options of «{key}» repeat a value.
errors.UNIT_ONLY_FOR_NUMBER: Only a number has a unit.
errors.VAT_RATE_INVALID: The VAT rate is between 0 and 100.
errors.PARENT_NOT_ALLOWED: Only a city has a country.

lists.title: Reference lists
lists.subtitle: Sectors, opportunity sources, countries and cities chosen on customers, suppliers and shipments.

hints.sector: A customer's line of business; customer reports group by it.
hints.city: Each city belongs to a country; customers, suppliers and deliveries name it.

lists.empty: No values yet: the field is typed freely until one is added.
lists.legacyHint: These were typed freely on records. Map each one to an item: every module then stores that item's key on its own records.
